new_items.title: permissions.blockWritesOutsideWorkingDirectories (v2.1.314)
new_items.why: One setting enforces 'lanes write only inside their copy' in every permission mode. Small.

new_items.title: permissions.denyInsteadOfPrompting (v2.1.319)
new_items.why: For cron and unattended Leads: a Terminal write once waited 7.4 h on a prompt; this denies instead and the turn continues.

new_items.title: Scheduled tasks and /loop ask before running a skill that declares allowed-tools or hooks; Skill(name) in permissions.allow runs it unattended (v2.1.325)
new_items.why: Check now: the 30-min check runs the lead-watch skill and this can stall it. Verify the allow rule exists.

new_items.title: Self-paced /loop ends when a turn finishes without rescheduling; CLAUDE_CODE_LOOP_KEEPALIVE=1 keeps the old behaviour (v2.1.319)
new_items.why: Check now: could silently end the check loop.

new_items.title: Sandboxed Bash follows the normal permission flow by default (v2.1.325)
new_items.why: Check now: may add prompts to lane scripts; set sandbox.autoAllowBashIfSandboxed deliberately or not.

new_items.title: Security fixes: deny rules not covering cp/mv; sandbox escape of a read-only Bash command (v2.1.321)
new_items.why: Update: guards that rely on deny rules were weaker before.

new_items.title: Security fix: Edit(path) deny bypass by redirect (v2.1.309)
new_items.why: Update: guards that rely on deny rules were weaker before.

new_items.title: CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_EFFORT (v2.1.316)
new_items.why: Sets effort for reviewer subagents in one place (fits the repo's effort rule).

new_items.title: Agent SDK hook callbacks onFailure: "block" (v2.1.317)
new_items.why: Useful only if guards move into SDK code.

new_items.title: claude remote-control --settings <file>, --hold-idle-file, --max-hold-min (v2.1.311, v2.1.321)
new_items.why: Relevant if Remote Control sessions are used to start lanes.

new_items.title: Claude Fable 5.2 is the default Fable model (v2.1.321)
new_items.why: Repo rules keep Fable for planning only; check effort and cost before switching.
